ACME CORPORATION — PASSWORD POLICY
Document ID: SEC-PWD-2025-001 | Effective: January 1, 2025

PASSWORD REQUIREMENTS
All employees must use passwords of at least 14 characters.
Passwords must include uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.
Passwords must be changed every 90 days.
Shared or default passwords are prohibited.

ACCOUNT LOCKOUT
After 5 consecutive failed login attempts, accounts are locked for 30 minutes.
Repeated lockout events trigger an automatic security incident ticket.

ADMIN ACCOUNTS
Privileged accounts require 20-character passwords and hardware MFA.

CONTACT: security@acme-corp.com
